body: Stand in the square and look at the yellow opera house. The hall is of an age with the opera houses in Hanoi and Saigon. The Lê Chân statue is on the same strip. The visit is the building and the square.
Come in the evening if the center is your night. The walk continues toward Tam Bạc. Skip the square if the day is only the sand at Đồ Sơn. How long you stay is Check on arrival.
